My bypass mutations of the reader2 run all fail R2: the old wide spawnSync (spawnSync called twice; ran 0 times through sandboxRun), execFileSync via a second require of child_process, require("child_" + "process").spawnSync, an aliased spawnSync (ran 0 times through sandboxRun), NODE_OPTIONS=--allow-fs-read of the whole cache in sandboxRun’s env (the probe reads bsdata and donors), and a sandboxRun that logs the sandbox argv but returns a second wide run (spawnSync twice). With the round-2 grant mutations (bsdata in SANDBOX_CACHE, the whole cache, --allow-child-process, an extra read, no --permission) also failing, the text is held. The one evasion I found needs deliberate obfuscation of agree.js itself: run reader2 through sandboxRun and then again through an alias of spawnSync and use that result; a static check cannot rule that out, and agree.js is reviewed code. Not a reason to hold this.
